summary: A Depth subscription across a dropped socket: the book and price merged before the drop do not survive it; the next connection's first book comes without the old price.

notes: Audit RB-06 (prior-session state): the web clears its merged fields when a connection ends; the desktop clears them in on_connected (1.0.6).
The session token is sent percent-decoded in x-session-token (samcoWebSocket.py: unquote).

deviations.reason: The web sends Samco's ch and chPer as change and change_percentage for every instrument; the desktop sends a change for indices only (common carrier, audit C04).
The web sends Samco's ch and chPer as change and change_percentage for every instrument; the desktop sends a change for indices only (common carrier, audit C04).

The web sends Depth clients nothing on a quote packet (samco_adapter.py _on_data routes quote frames to LTP and Quote subscriptions only), so a Depth-only client's price, volume and OI stand still until Samco's next book; the desktop refreshes Depth from the cached book on every quote packet, under its one frame per held mode policy (audit C08).
deviations.ref: samco_adapter.py _on_data (target_modes [3] for quote2, [1, 2] for quote); audit C08; lead ruling 2026-11-09

deviations.reason: The desktop sends Samco's web name for last_quantity (last_trade_quantity, which the web's Quote frames carry) in Depth frames too, beside last_quantity; the web's Depth frames carry last_quantity only.
deviations.ref: feed::dialect (WS-05): aliases in Quote and Depth alike

deviations.reason: The web's Samco adapter puts its subscription mode number (1, 2, 3) in data.mode; the desktop sends the label (ltp, quote, full). Follows the web adapter in Phase B through wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Samco: the number).
Before Samco's first quote frame the desktop sends oi 0, a value Samco did not send (the quote2 stream carries no OI): it must be left out with the other quote fields.
deviations.ref: streaming.rs quote_tick (int of a missing oI); feed::bridge depth_update

deviations.reason: The web's Samco adapter sends no open_interest key beside oi; the desktop sends both. Follows the web adapter in Phase B through wire's per-broker switch in the dialect table (Samco: no open_interest).
